description: Ice Cloud Imager (ICI) first flight model, RTTOV Metop-SG satellite id 2. The curves are the channel spectral response functions distributed by the EUMETSAT NWP SAF for the RTTOV radiative-transfer model, converted from frequency to wavelength; bands chNN follow the RTTOV channel order.
short_description: Ice Cloud Imager (ICI) first flight model, Metop-SG: channel SRFs

links.label: NWP SAF SRF page for RTTOV sensor metopsg_2_ici
NWP SAF spectral response functions index

licence.terms: No terms of use are stated on the NWP SAF SRF pages or in the files. The NWP SAF SRF index lists sensors whose 'SRFs cannot be published due to licence restrictions' separately; this sensor's SRFs are published there.
licence.scope: EUMETSAT NWP SAF distribution of originator data (see notes). Hosted under Nill's 2026-10-26 'host everything' decision.

notes: NWP SAF README_SRF: 'Data obtained from EUMETSAT for the ICI instrument. This is the first flight model. Date received: 23/03/2022 .mat files contains the Frequency [Hz], Gain with respect to peak [dB] and uncertainty [dB]. Cutoff applied for gains' Zeros added just inside gaps between separate passbands. Pivots agree with the page's central frequencies within 1% except double-sideband channels, whose pivot lies between the sidebands. DetectorType energy is assumed.
